plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Political Science Major (BA) program page (poid=925). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The introduction states the major consists of twelve courses: six required core courses and six additional POLI or approved interdisciplinary electives. The program page prints no hour total and no residency note; the recorded total (36) is the exact itemized minimum -- the six core courses at 18 plus the six elective slots at the catalog's printed minimum of 3 hours each. SSCI 255's printed prerequisite, SSCI 130, is a core course in this plan and is recorded. SSCI 395's course description lists the capstone as serving majors in Communication & Media Studies, Health Advocacy & Humanitarian Systems, Nonprofit Management & Community Leadership, Political Science, and Sociology; the Health Advocacy & Humanitarian Systems name does not match any program name in this catalog edition, as printed, and is disclosed here without effect on this plan.

courses.title: Political Science Elective
courses.choice_note: Select any one POLI elective or approved course from another discipline (3 hours minimum), as printed; the program requires six such electives, recorded as six slots at the printed minimum of 3 Hour(s) each. The catalog enumerates no POLI elective list on the program page. The one approved elective the catalog names specifically is RELI 265 Religion and Migration in America (3 Hour(s); its detail page prints Prerequisite(s): None and Corequisite(s): None); it is disclosed here rather than listed as an option, because the catalog does not present it as this slot's option list. A completion using an elective printed above 3 hours totals more than the recorded total, as printed.
